doc: The menus track's page sounds (M2-AUD-14; assets_src/sfx/menu_page_sfx.py; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "M3 menus"). Same row format as sfx.json; AudioData.sfx_rows merges this file in. All on the UI bus at -20 LUFS momentary max. ui_sfx.json's hooks play them by listening: the Items page (ItemsMenu: an item used, the bag re-sorted), Formation (FormationMenu: a hero picked up, two heroes trading places or one moving to an open place), Customize inside EquipMenu (its recipes opening, an ability crafted into a piece) and the zone map (ZoneMapView: the map panned, a sparse train of soft paper slides under its cooldown, 6 dB under the other UI rows). Those classes are on claude/menus, not here yet, so their hooks are pending.
